provenance: RTN FP8attn+NVFP4mlp mixed requant, measured 2026-08-19 (receipts/requant-rtn-first-serve-2026-08-19.md, receipts/requant-gptq-w4a4-2026-08-19.md). KLD on the 512-ctx shard-0 suite via fidelity.py capture+replay (receipts/kld-reports/report-rtn-fp8attn-nvfp4mlp.json). PP crude single-request. GPTQ variant measured worse (0.028548 [0.026393, 0.031012]) with CIs disjoint from RTN -- see receipt for the concatenate_data starvation diagnosis (512 samples -> 42 sequences). This baseline gates the requant lane; the flagship trellis checkpoint has its own baseline-flagship.json.
note: No requant artifact currently meets the public-promotion gate (KLD mean <= 0.012 AND ci95 upper <= 0.012). RTN at 0.022121 is the best measured but is 1.84x over the bar. The gate is recorded here so a future calibrated artifact can be checked against it. KLD protocol: 512-context shard-0 suite, 2047 scored positions x 512 contexts, full 248,320 vocab, body-only shared BF16 LM-head replay.

kld_mean.description: Token mean KLD on the 512-ctx shard-0 suite. North-star criterion 3: must be <= 0.012 for public promotion.

kld_ci95_upper.description: Upper bound of the 95% bootstrap CI on context-macro mean KLD. Public-promotion gate requires this <= 0.012.

kld_p99.description: p99 KLD. North-star criterion 4: must be <= 0.15.

pp_tok_s.description: Crude single-request prefill throughput at 2051 tokens. The W4A4-MLP RTN variant measured 8876.8 but produced garbage output from an uncalibrated static activation scale.

sanity_paris.description: Model answers 'The capital of France is' with text containing 'Paris'.
